pending_launch_choices.batch_boundary_guard: native TrainSink._maybe_batch is blocked during group assembly and released only after the current deterministic complete-group prefix pass receipt; first passes use six groups and small refills use only the groups needed to reach 24
pending_launch_choices.batch_size_24_runtime_compatibility: must pass a node-free Prime adapter check before allocation; six task groups times four rollouts give 24 trace capacity per sampling cycle, while admitted traces may span cycles to fill an optimizer batch
pending_launch_choices.bootstrap: bootstrap.py/bootstrap.sh are prepared but unrun; on an explicit Linux execution they accept only exact 1+1, 2+2, or 4+4 train/inference GPU topologies, with 4+4 reserved for an 8-GPU whole-node offer split into four trainer and four inference GPUs; verify public pinned downloads, run the reviewed renderer sandbox helper plus materialization/preflight/canary, and write ready_no_launch without starting Prime
pending_launch_choices.prime_tail_purge_hook: required runtime hook must physically consume and purge the recorded stage-tail trace IDs before an optimizer-target receipt can advance stages
pending_launch_choices.real_backward_canary: optional explicit --real-backward-canary mode; exactly one optimizer update, one native resumable checkpoint, one verified public portable adapter, declared elapsed <= 2400 seconds, declared attempt cost <= 9 USD, and zero leftover processes are required
pending_launch_choices.renderer_canary: must measure the repaired renderer tail before any scaled rental
pending_launch_choices.sampling_attempt_accounting: each admitted attempt, including censored retries and bounded partial refills, increments persisted per-stage attempts and is bounded by the two-times refill cap
pending_launch_choices.stage_quality_threshold: no unregistered quality threshold is applied; optimizer target completion advances the schedule, while receipts require valid admitted groups and explicit family quotas
pending_launch_choices.stale_group_cancellation: stale GroupCancellation voids every arrived member as pipeline evidence and never enters the trainer candidate inventory
pending_launch_choices.text_only_vision_memory_preflight: required; launch fails closed unless the pinned Prime/model integration exposes a tested frozen-vision omission or offload hook, or the prepared trainer memory contract is explicitly at least 80 GiB
pending_launch_choices.token_length_balance_preflight: required; launch fails closed unless the pinned Prime integration exposes the prepare_batch sequence-length measurement and four-rank balanced_partition hook

bootstrap_scope.renderer_sandbox_helper: reviewed prepare_renderer_runtime.py/patch_brush_centroid.py with a root-to-runuser painter boundary

canary_scope.scope: pinned Prime config, trainer dependency imports, import hook, console scripts, and one bounded real renderer probe

runtime_binding.batch_boundary: _maybe_batch is allowed only after the active complete-group-prefix pass; in-group calls are fail-closed and cannot ship carry-over traces
runtime_binding.dispatch_gate: binding-owned complete-group-prefix gate is layered with Prime lead permission; active groups drain while fresh dispatch is paused
runtime_binding.optimizer_update_confirmation: TrainBatch selection is journaled first; only WeightWatcher.on_update for the expected policy version records the optimizer update
runtime_binding.resume_scope: only clean optimizer/stage boundaries or a persisted exact selected-batch/update/tail-purge reconciliation may resume; partial native buffers fail closed
runtime_binding.trainer_candidate_inventory: controller inventory contains only exact trace IDs present in native TrainSink.pending_batch after process_group
